ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms and transaction details from the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- Parties (America First Multifamily Investors, L.P. as borrower, BankUnited N.A. as administrative agent, etc.)
- Dates (original credit agreement June 11, 2021; amendment November 30, 2021)
- Corporate structure details (America First Capital Associates Limited Partnership Two as general partner, Greystone AF Manager LLC)
- Guarantor change to Greystone Select Incorporated
- Lender composition (BankUnited N.A. and Bankers Trust Company)
- First priority perfected liens provision
- Release provisions
- Covenant modification terms

The memo appropriately marks unavailable terms (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, etc.) as "N/A" rather than making unsupported claims. All substantive financial and legal terms referenced in the memo have clear support in the source amendment document.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms that are actually present in the source document. While many typical financial terms like deal size, interest rate, and maturity date are marked as "N/A" in the deal terms table, this accurately reflects that these terms are not specified in this First Amendment document. The memo correctly identifies and includes all the material transaction terms that are present in the source, including:

- Party names (borrower, administrative agent, lenders)
- Key dates (original credit agreement date of June 11, 2021, and amendment date of November 30, 2021)
- Guarantor arrangements (Greystone Select Incorporated)
- Collateral provisions (first priority perfected liens)
- Modified covenant and consent requirements
- The comprehensive release provisions

The source document is an amendment focused on specific modifications rather than a comprehensive credit agreement, so the absence of detailed financial terms is expected and appropriately handled by the memo.
